# Combination Sleepers: How to Choose a Mattress That Supports Movement


By Bianca Sanchez


Sep 12, 2026


---


### Share this article


#### The best bed for side and stomach sleepers is often a medium-firm hybrid design that balances cushioning around the shoulders and hips with support through the lower back. For combination sleepers who move between side and stomach positions during the night, factors such as mattress firmness, responsiveness and overall construction can make a meaningful difference in comfort. Understanding how these elements work together can help you choose a mattress for multiple sleep positions with greater confidence.


## The Best Mattress for Combination Sleepers Who Switch Between Side and Stomach


#### For combination sleepers who switch between their side and stomach, a medium-firm hybrid mattress may offer a balance of cushioning and support. This type of construction is designed to combine contouring comfort layers with a supportive base, which can help accommodate multiple sleep positions.


### Why Medium-Firm Wins


#### Medium-firm mattresses are often described as falling between 6 and 7 on a 10-point firmness scale. Because comfort preferences vary, combination sleepers may choose to compare mattresses within this range when evaluating different options.


### Hybrid Construction Delivers Both


#### Hybrid mattresses feature a combination of comfort layers and a support system. For combination sleepers evaluating different mattress types, hybrid construction is one option that may be considered during the shopping process.
